preview_mean_latency_ms.Description: Mean across the participant's preview trials of detection latency, restricted to trials where the first fixation beginning more than 100 ms after onset landed on the face. Detection latency: onset of the last fixation of the trial (the one that landed on the face) relative to search-display onset. Fixations beginning within 100 ms of onset are discarded, timeout trials are dropped, and in the face detection task the stimuli in config.EXCLUDE_STIMULI are excluded.

no_preview_mean_latency_ms.Description: Mean across the participant's no-preview trials of detection latency, restricted to trials where the first fixation beginning more than 100 ms after onset landed on the face. Detection latency: onset of the last fixation of the trial (the one that landed on the face) relative to search-display onset. Fixations beginning within 100 ms of onset are discarded, timeout trials are dropped, and in the face detection task the stimuli in config.EXCLUDE_STIMULI are excluded.
